QIONGQI
CR 5

You turn at the sound of a familiar voice, but what lands nearby is a winged tiger with the gleam of malicious cunning in its eyes.

XP 1,600
CE Large magical beast
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +3 natural armor, -1 size)
hp 51 (6d10+18)
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft. fly 120 ft. (average)
Melee bite +12 (2d6+6 plus grab) and 2 claws +13 (1d8+6 plus grab)
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +13, 1d8+6)

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 15, Con 17, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Attack +6; CMB 12; CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Bluff), Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Acrobatics +11, Bluff +15, Fly +7, Perception +5, Stealth +7, Survival +5; Racial Modifiers +8 Bluff, +4 Acrobatics
SQ sound mimicry (voices)

Sound Mimicry (Ex)

The creature perfectly imitates certain sounds or even specific voices. The creature attempts a Bluff check opposed by the listener’s Sense Motive check to recognize the mimicry, although if the listener isn’t familiar with the person or type of creatures mimicked, it takes a –8 penalty on its Sense Motive check. The creature has a +8 racial bonus on its Bluff check to mimic sounds (including accents and speech patterns, if a voice mimic) it has listened to for at least 10 minutes. The creature cannot duplicate the effects of magical abilities (such as bardic performance or a harpy’s captivating song), though it may be able to mimic the sound of those abilities. This ability does not allow the creature to speak or understand languages it doesn’t know.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

The qiongqi is a devious creature that hunts for food and for fun. They take joy in using their ability to mimic voices and their glib tongue to trick creatures into traps, deadly situations, or into an ambush. They enjoy killing, and sometimes eating sentient creatures after they trick them.
